text: Pulldowns make your back wide. So what makes it thick?
Rowing pulls the weight toward your torso, and trains your mid back, lats, and rear delts.
Barbell rows let you go heavy. Dumbbell rows give a big range, one arm at a time. Cable rows keep constant tension. And chest-supported rows take your lower back out of it.
Tuck your elbows for more lats. Flare them for more upper back.
